integrity: All-index classification is supplied by the algebraic extension-pattern proof; finite executable checks corroborate the finite boundary cases and logical-type reduction. Claims of independent certification are not made.
scientific_limitations: The group operation is a ternary relation with a named identity; indices n >= 3. The 48-element bound is sharp only inside the dihedral family. No independent validation; possibly equivalent unindexed or unpublished analyses are not ruled out.
title: Thirteen rank-two theories of finite dihedral groups
